known_limitations.description: Milvus Lite uses single-process SQLite/local database file; parallel multi-process writes cause lock contention. Resolved by single-writer index queue lease lock.
CPU-bound ONNX all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embedding generation takes ~30-50ms per batch. Mitigated by asynchronous WAL queuing.
Advisory <file>.lock files coordinate cooperating subagents, but do not prevent external OS editors from modifying files.
